item.title: BAMAMON Recalls LED Projecting Finger Light Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
item.company: Sold At: Amazon.com from March 2025 through August 2026 for about $13 to $14.
item.brand: Sold At: Amazon.com from March 2025 through August 2026 for about $13 to $14.
item.product: Bamamon LED Projecting Finger Light Toys
item.summary: This recall involves Bamamon LED Projecting Finger Light toys which contain three button cells batteries. The finger lights come in 32 pieces in a box in red, orange, blue, black, purple, clear, green and yellow. The finger lights project eight space themed patterns such as astronauts, rockets, UFO, galaxy and solar systems printed on labels located on the front of the package.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Bamamon LED Projecting Finger Light Toys.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the toys immediately and contact Bamamon. Consumers will be asked to email a photograph showing the product being properly disposed of in the trash to bamamonproductrecall@outlook.com.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
